name: internvla-n1-lite3-isaac-sim
title: InternVLA-N1 driving a Lite3 in Isaac Sim
description: Close the embodiment gap: a Lite3 articulation walking in Isaac Sim under InternVLA-N1's own velocity output, with robot-mounted RGB feeding the model, so the VLA's decisions are tested against a robot that actually has to execute them. Habitat only tests the decision; it has no robot body.
creator: sun
